status: Implementation requirements and source-checked guidance; no completed human linguistic review is claimed.
astra_instruction_tr: Sloven dili uzmanı titizliğiyle çalış. Sitenin görünen ve erişilebilir bütün metinlerini, SEO alanlarını, sistem mesajlarını, e-postalarını ve indirilebilir PDF/WebP içeriklerini doğal, dil bilgisi ve yazım bakımından kusursuz standart Slovenceyle hazırla. Slovenceyi Slovakçayla karıştırma. Çeviri kalıntısı, İngilizce varsayılan metin, hatalı ikil biçim, yanlış çekim veya eksik č/š/ž kabul etme. Fran/ZRC SAZU ve Unicode CLDR kaynaklarıyla denetle; belirsiz ifadeleri doğrulanmış sade bir yapıyla yeniden yaz. Yapılmamış bir insan dil uzmanı incelemesini yapılmış gibi gösterme.

editorial_policy.voice: Use concise, natural standard Slovene. The glossary chooses the singular imperative for actions: Prenesi, Natisni, Izberi. Keep this voice consistent within a flow.
editorial_policy.capitalization: Use sentence case. Month and weekday names are lowercase in ordinary text and calendar headings; normal sentence-initial capitalization still applies. Do not apply English title case or automatic capitalize-every-word CSS.
editorial_policy.zodiac: Zodiac sign names are lowercase in running text; constellation names are a separate naming context. Preserve normal sentence-initial capitalization in labels.
editorial_policy.terminology: Use državni prazniki and dela prosti dnevi as distinct concepts. GOV.SI is a terminology source here; holiday inclusion and current legal status still come from the project's separately verified legal dataset.
editorial_policy.calendar_meanings: Keep Koledar z imenom for personalized printable calendars and Godovi for sourced name-day information. Do not imply that every given name has one verified name day.
editorial_policy.brand: Preserve the exact brand/domain koledar365.si. Localize the surrounding wording without translating or inflecting the domain.

operands.i: Integer digits of the absolute numeric value.
operands.v: Number of visible fraction digits, including trailing zeroes. Compute from the displayed precision, not from an already simplified numeric value.

implementation_checks: Configure the same complete Slovene plural rules in Ruby and the browser; test the actual localization runtime with these fixtures. A one/other mapping or a last-digit-only test is insufficient.

Keep names, files, results and template counts as integers. Preserve displayed decimal precision for metrics that legitimately have fractions; numeric 1 and displayed 1,0 do not share a CLDR category.
Translate complete messages with the required noun, verb, adjective, gender and case agreement. Do not assemble sentences from independently translated fragments.

A CLDR category selects a software message branch; it is not a universal noun-declension rule. Review fractional-unit grammar separately, and do not reuse the integer calendar-count examples for decimal values.

dates_numbers_and_case.number_instruction: Use a sl-SI number formatter and match its visible precision in plural selection. Do not expose English decimal punctuation or English month/day names.
dates_numbers_and_case.month_case_instruction: Use nominative month names for calendar headings. CLDR's Slovene date strings use nominative month forms. ZRC SAZU permits nominative or genitive in standalone document dates; in a sentence, syntax determines the case. Maintain separate standalone-date and prose-date patterns instead of globally replacing every month with a genitive form.
dates_numbers_and_case.holiday_names: Preserve verified Slovene holiday names and proper-name capitalization from the legal dataset. Do not lowercase all holiday strings indiscriminately.

names_and_font_quality.name_rule: Display exact NFC name spelling from the authoritative name registry. Preserve spaces, hyphens, diacritics and foreign letters. Never translate a name or infer its grammatical behavior solely from statistical sex or its final letter.
names_and_font_quality.declension_rule: Avoid automatic possessives and case changes across the 8,561-name candidate inventory. Use a neutral heading such as {name_exact} – koledar za tiskanje and a field such as Ime: {name_exact}. Use an inflected name only when its individual form and context have been verified.
names_and_font_quality.minimum_font_fixture: č š ž Č Š Ž — Ana, Žan, Zan, Saša, Ana Marija, Ana-Marija
names_and_font_quality.render_checks: Check glyph coverage for every actual registry character, long and multiword names, uppercase/lowercase diacritics and punctuation. Embed suitable fonts in PDF, retain searchable text where possible, and inspect both PDF and final WebP rendering. Never strip diacritics to work around a missing font.
names_and_font_quality.url_rule: Language cleanup must not recompute persisted canonical slugs or merge Žan with Zan. Display typography and URL allocation are separate concerns.

ui_glossary_note: These are proposed consistent editorial labels, not a claim that an official source prescribes every button. Context-specific sentences still need grammar review.

ui_glossary.generic_error: Prišlo je do napake. Poskusi znova.

full_surface_audit: Navigation, headings, body text, breadcrumbs, filters, search suggestions, result counts and all interactive calendar/planner/tool labels.
Daily dated horoscope, zodiac and lunar explanations, source notes, correction notes and dates; original natural Slovene wording rather than literal English syntax.
Form labels, placeholders, validation, empty states, loading states, status badges, dialogs, notifications, tooltips, keyboard instructions and screen-reader/ARIA labels.
Page title, meta description, Open Graph and social-card text, structured-data human-readable text, meaningful image ALT text and captions. Decorative images keep empty ALT where appropriate.
Download labels and filenames, Content-Disposition display filename, PDF document metadata, headings, month/week labels, legends and brand footer, plus all visible words in WebP images.
All 15 downloadable layouts in each format and each offered year 2027–2030; short, long and diacritic-containing names must remain readable without incorrect truncation.
Cookie banner and preferences, consent explanations, privacy/terms pages, contact/about/editorial pages, 404/500/error pages, email subject lines, confirmations and message bodies.

Mobile/desktop and print layouts, browser-native or third-party controls and any fallback text. Apply locale metadata consistently: HTML sl-SI and Open Graph sl_SI. Keep code identifiers and actual protocol field names unchanged.
release_gate: Maintain one shared Slovene message catalog and this terminology glossary; identify untranslated keys and English fallback text in every surface.
Run the listed plural fixtures through the actual application localization code; separately review complete sentences, dual agreement and decimal-unit cases.
Inspect rendered pages and representative generated assets for language, spacing, diacritics, clipped text, metadata and the exact koledar365.si footer.
Record what Astra checked and which primary references resolved uncertain wording. If a qualified human Slovene reviewer is used, record that review accurately; otherwise never claim one occurred.
Correct unresolved grammar, meaning and translation issues before publication. Use a simpler verified sentence when a difficult form cannot be established confidently.
